label: Claude A · voxel
about: Blocky voxel figures, one cube size for everything (about 3 cm), face drawn as pixel blocks, glasses as a block frame one voxel off the face. Rigid parts on 7 bones, Minecraft-style swing walk.
attempts: Smaller ID card, headphone cups with teal rings, bigger bun; Eric's hoodie strings and card smaller, more hair volume.
Eric: darker stubble, darker glasses frame, hair down to the nape, bigger ponytail.
Eric's hair combed back in steps instead of a straight fringe.

label: Claude B · toy figure
about: Toy-figure proportions (minifig, Playmobil) from clean primitives: cylinder head with a printed-style face, trapezoid torso, legs that swing from one hip pin, C-clip hands, clip-on hair pieces, glossy plastic.
attempts: First build. Weak: the head's top shows through the hair as a pale band, the teal piece covers Mio's eyes.
Hair pieces bigger, teal piece moved to the back. Weak: the pale band is still there.
Hair pieces fitted closer. Weak: band still on Eric.
Hair pieces wider. Weak: band still on Eric.
Hair raised: band gone, but both hair pieces are tall egg-shaped helmets. Weak.
Head rebuilt as a cylinder with a low dome so the hair can hug it.
Mio's side strand round and tapered, glasses frame bars longer.
Eric's hair sides slope back (combed back); glasses corners no longer show black dots.

label: Claude C · faceted low-poly
about: Tall faceted low-poly, flat-shaded planes, a small head on a long body; silhouette first (Mio an A: a bell-shaped oversized hoodie on thin legs; Eric a V: broad blazer shoulders over a narrow waist). Face is only glasses, eye planes and brows. Knees in the walk.
attempts: First build. Weak: teal frames Mio's face on both sides, Eric's hair sits like a helmet.
Mio's hair opened at the face, teal only at the nape and on her left (image right); smaller eyes; Eric's hairline higher with a lighter combed strip on top.
Glasses bars overlap at the corners (black dots still visible).
